"""P35 M3 certification: nine adversarial mutation checks (scratch only, never committed).

Each mutant is applied to its own fresh ``git archive HEAD`` export; the real
worktree is never modified. Before a run the edit must match exactly once and
the mutated file must compile. Import resolution is probed so the export's
``src`` (not the worktree's) is what the tests exercise. A mutant is KILLED
only when pytest exits 1 (test failures, not collection/usage/internal errors),
no import/syntax error appears, and every node expected to catch it FAILED.
An unmutated control export must pass the union of all selected nodes first.
"""

BAD_ERRORS = re.compile(r"\b(ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|SyntaxError|IndentationError)\b")


def export(root: Path) -> None:
    data = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(WORKTREE), "archive", "--format=tar", "HEAD"],
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    ).stdout
    root.mkdir(parents=True)
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data)) as archive:
        archive.extractall(root, filter="data")


def environment(root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        **os.environ,
        "PYTHONPATH": f"{root / 'src'};{root / 'tests'}",
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "1",
        "MKL_NUM_THREADS": "1",
        "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "1",
        "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS": "1",
        "TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM": "false",
        "HF_HUB_OFFLINE": "1",
        "HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE": "1",
        "UV_OFFLINE": "true",
    }


def run(name: str, edits: list[tuple[str, str, str]], nodes: list[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    root = SCRATCH / name
    export(root)
    for relative, old, new in edits:
        target = root / relative
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        count = text.count(old)
        if count != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: edit anchor in {relative} matched {count} times")
        target.write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        py_compile.compile(str(target), doraise=True, cfile=str(root / "compile_check.pyc"))
    env = environment(root)
    imported = subprocess.run(
        [str(PYTHON), "-c", "import xlm; print(xlm.__file__)"],
        cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    ).stdout.strip()  # fmt: skip
    if not Path(imported).is_relative_to(root / "src"):
        raise SystemExit(f"{name}: xlm resolved outside the export: {imported}")
    started = time.monotonic()
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [str(PYTHON), "-m", "pytest", *nodes, "-n", "0", "-rA", "-p", "no:cacheprovider"],
        cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True,
    )  # fmt: skip
    seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
    output = completed.stdout + completed.stderr
    (SCRATCH / f"{name}.log").write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
    outcomes = {
        m.group(2): m.group(1)
        for m in re.finditer(r"^(PASSED|FAILED|ERROR|SKIPPED) (.+?)(?: - .*)?$", output, re.M)
    }
    summary = next(
        (line for line in reversed(output.splitlines()) if re.search(r"\d+ (passed|failed)", line)),
        "",
    )
    return {
        "name": name,
        "files": sorted({e[0] for e in edits}),
        "imported": imported,
        "nodes": nodes,
        "exit": completed.returncode,
        "outcomes": outcomes,
        "summary": summary.strip("= "),
        "bad_errors": sorted(set(BAD_ERRORS.findall(output))),
        "assertions": [
            line for line in output.splitlines() if line.startswith("E ")
        ][:12],
        "seconds": seconds,
    }


def main() -> int:
    only = set(sys.argv[1:])
    SCRATCH.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    results: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    if not only or "control" in only:
        union = sorted({node for _, nodes in MUTANTS.values() for node in nodes})
        shutil.rmtree(SCRATCH / "control", ignore_errors=True)
        control = run("control", [], union)
        control["verdict"] = (
            "CONTROL_GREEN"
            if control["exit"] == 0
            and all(control["outcomes"].get(n) == "PASSED" for n in union)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            else "CONTROL_NOT_GREEN"
        )
        results.append(control)
        print(json.dumps(control), flush=True)
        if control["verdict"] != "CONTROL_GREEN":
            (SCRATCH / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            return 2
    for name, (edits, nodes) in MUTANTS.items():
        if only and name not in only:
            continue
        shutil.rmtree(SCRATCH / name, ignore_errors=True)
        result = run(name, edits, nodes)
        failed_all = all(result["outcomes"].get(n) == "FAILED" for n in nodes)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
        result["verdict"] = (
            "KILLED"
            if result["exit"] == 1 and failed_all and not result["bad_errors"]
            else "SURVIVED_OR_INVALID"
        )
        results.append(result)
        print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
    (SCRATCH / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return 0 if all(r["verdict"] in ("KILLED", "CONTROL_GREEN") for r in results) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
